## Section 2 — Identity & Mission

This repository is a **self-growing knowledge base** on **the country south korea**, a member of the [`ai-world-view`](https://github.com/ai-world-view) lineage. Its mission is to accumulate a factual, neutral, encyclopedic body of knowledge about South Korea — its geography, history, government, economy, culture, and people — one growth tick at a time, written from the model's own world view (no external sources are fetched during authoring). Growth is orchestrated centrally by the hub; this repo does not grow itself.

## Section 3 — Architecture

The repository holds only its own content, a GitHub Pages `_config.yml` (a `remote_theme` consumer of [`bamr87/zer0-mistakes`](https://github.com/bamr87/zer0-mistakes)), the `_data/navigation` config, a `ROADMAP.md` growth plan, the `.claude/` adapter toolkit, and `telemetry/`. The AI customization layer is staged from the hub into `.github/` at tick time (`.claude/` holds thin adapters that point to it). The staged framework layer present this tick:

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `.github/agents/architect.agent.md` | Orchestrator agent for an end-to-end growth tick |
| `.github/agents/curator.agent.md` | Content specialist agent (research + author topics) |
| `.github/instructions/agents.instructions.md` | Standards for the agent/customization layer |
| `.github/instructions/content.instructions.md` | Content, source, and formatting standards |
| `.github/prompts/grow.prompt.md` | One autonomous growth tick |
| `.github/prompts/deep-dive.prompt.md` | Long-form single-topic article |
| `.github/prompts/update-readme.prompt.md` | Populate/expand the README knowledge table |
| `.github/prompts/encode-seed.prompt.md` | Append a session record to §8 |
| `.github/prompts/publish.prompt.md` | Commit + push the session |
| `.github/prompts/evolve.prompt.md` | Audit/improve the customization layer |
| `.github/prompts/distill.prompt.md` | Lineage meta-review and portable seed |
| `.github/prompts/expand.prompt.md` | Finer-granularity growth after consolidation |
| `.github/skills/add-topic/SKILL.md` | Add one or more topics (research → format → create → link) |
| `.github/skills/research/SKILL.md` | Structured research; writes nothing |
| `.github/skills/build-structure/SKILL.md` | Generate/refresh indices, timeline, TOC, cross-refs |
| `.github/skills/sync-seed/SKILL.md` | Regenerate seed.md §1–7 from the live repo |
| `.github/skills/plan-roadmap/SKILL.md` | Decide next work; maintain ROADMAP.md |
| `.github/skills/publish-session/SKILL.md` | Log → commit → push flow |
| `.github/skills/learn/SKILL.md` | Capture cycle learnings into the framework |
| `.github/skills/pollinate/SKILL.md` | Cross-pollinate framework changes across the lineage |

Added three dedicated articles — two giving Culture & Society its twenty-sixth and twenty-seventh topics (the indigenous *gugak* and shamanic traditions underpinning Korea's cultural heritage) and one giving Economy a nineteenth (the entrepreneurial economy that emerged alongside the chaebol).

- Created `culture-society/korean-traditional-music.md`: encyclopedic article on gugak — the ancient and court-music (*jeongak*) foundations and the *Akhak kwebom* and *jeongganbo* notation, traditional instruments (gayageum, daegeum, haegeum, janggu) and instrumental genres, pansori and *minyo* vocal traditions, *jangdan* rhythmic cycles and modal (*jo*) theory, ritual and mask-dance contexts, master performers and the Intangible Cultural Property system, the National Gugak Center and conservatory training, the samulnori revival and fusion, and UNESCO recognition.
- Created `culture-society/shamanism-and-muism.md`: encyclopedic article on Muism — its pre-Buddhist origins and the *sin* spirit cosmology, the *mudang* and the *gut* ritual, initiation through *shin-byeong* and the *gangsinmu*/*seseummu* and regional traditions, suppression under Joseon Confucianism and Japanese colonial rule, modernization and revival, its coexistence with Buddhism and Christianity, its portrayal in film (*The Wailing*, *The Medium*), and contemporary debates over commercialization and gender.
- Created `economy/tech-startups-venture-capital.md`: encyclopedic article on the startup and VC ecosystem — the pre-2010 internet/gaming foundations and the 2010s policy turn (the "Creative Economy" and "Startup Korea"), the VC landscape (KVCA, KVIC's *motae* fund-of-funds, corporate and international VCs), the major unicorns (Coupang, Baemin/Woowa Brothers, Toss, Krafton, Webtoon Entertainment, Hyperconnect), entrepreneurship culture, accelerators, sectors from fintech to AI, the Seoul–Pangyo clusters, the 2022–2023 funding correction, and ecosystem maturation.
- ENHANCE pass corrected facts and normalized cross-references. Music: fixed the samulnori hangul (사물놀이) and its four instruments (kkwaenggwari, jing, janggu, buk), removed a fabricated "boseong" bronze bell, corrected the *Akhak kwebom* compiler (Seong Hyeon, not "Seo Geoyeong"), replaced the invented term "otkkesan" with the *pansori daseot madang*, rewrote the *jangdan* list to real cycles (jinyangjo, jungmori, jungjungmori, jajinmori, hwimori, gutgeori, semachi) and the scale passage to modal (*pyeongjo*/*gyemyeonjo*) terms, corrected the *minyo* examples (Jeongseon/Jindo Arirang and the *gyeongto*/*seodo*/*namdo* families), named Confucian ritual music correctly (Jongmyo/Munmyo jeryeak) and fixed the UNESCO dates (pansori 2003/2008, Gangneung Danoje 2005, Namsadang Nori 2009, Gagok 2010). Shamanism: fixed deity terms (*gasin*/*Seongju*, *seonangsin*, *Chilseong*), the initiation ritual (*naerim-gut*) and spirit-mother (*sineomeoni*), reversed the backwards *gangsinmu* (north/central) vs *seseummu* (south) regional attribution, corrected the origin-myth term (*bon-puri*, not "sin-bappi") and the Danoje mask drama (*Gwanno Gamyeongeuk*), and fixed *The Wailing*'s shaman (Il-gwang, played by Hwang Jung-min) while removing a mis-cited *A Tale of Two Sisters*. Startups: corrected Kim Beom-su's background (left NHN, not Nexon), disentangled the KVCA (1989) from the KVIC (2005) and its *motae* fund-of-funds, fixed Bom Kim (a Harvard Business School dropout), the Baemin/Delivery Hero deal and its Yogiyo divestiture and the real Baemin/Yogiyo/Coupang Eats rivalry, removed the "Bluehole subsidiary" error, corrected the Creative Economy center pairings, and replaced inflated VC-investment figures with the ~7.7→6.8→5.3 trillion-won 2021–2023 arc. Converted all three files' `[[wikilink]]` Related lists to resolved, marker-wrapped markdown links and confirmed single-ISO front-matter dates (2026-09-08).

### G1-T38 — 2026-09-09 — Tick 38: The Baekje kingdom, the ginseng industry, and coffee culture deepen History, Economy, and Culture & Society

Added three dedicated articles — one giving History a fifteenth topic (a dedicated ancient-kingdom article beyond the collective Three Kingdoms coverage), one giving Economy a twentieth (a traditional-knowledge export sector), and one giving Culture & Society a twenty-eighth (a contemporary daily-life phenomenon).

- Created `history/baekje.md`: encyclopedic article on the Baekje kingdom (18 BCE–660 CE) — the Onjo founding legend and Mahan origins, the Wiryeseong/Ungjin/Sabi capitals, King Geunchogo's zenith, the Southern Dynasties tributary and maritime trade networks, the adoption of Buddhism (Marananta, 384) and its transmission to Yamato Japan, the refined "Baekje smile" aesthetic and Muryeong tomb material culture, the 553–554 rupture with Silla, the 660 fall at Hwangsanbeol and the 660–663 restoration ending at Baekgang, and the Korean and Japanese cultural legacy and 2015 UNESCO Baekje Historic Areas.
- Created `economy/ginseng-industry.md`: encyclopedic article on Korean ginseng and herbal medicine — the *Panax ginseng* tradition from Chinese and Korean texts and the *Dongui Bogam*, the Joseon state monopoly and Geumsan cultivation, agronomy (shade structures, the 4–6-year cycle, "ginseng sickness"), red/white/extract product forms and ginsenoside science, KGC's Cheong Kwan Jang brand and exports, the licensed *hanbang* (Oriental medicine) system, and challenges from competition, labor, and counterfeiting.
- Created `culture-society/coffee-culture.md`: encyclopedic article on South Korean coffee culture — Gojong-era origins and the 1902 Sontag Hotel, the instant "coffee mix" era (Dongsuh, Maxim), the 1999 Starbucks entry and the domestic value chains (Ediya, Mega, Compose), the cafe as urban "third place," themed and specialty third-wave scenes, the industry's economic weight and market saturation, labor and single-use-cup issues, and the global dalgona-coffee trend.
- ENHANCE pass corrected facts and normalized cross-references. Coffee: replaced a false claim that "Seo Pil-hoon won the World Barista Championship in 2014" with the first Korean champion, Jeon Joo-yeon in 2019; replaced the dubious tea term "dasilhwa" with *darye*; and removed a mismatched "traditional tea houses → Confucianism" cross-link. Ginseng: fixed a broken, mislabeled cross-reference (Geumsan's "South Chungcheong Province" link pointed to South Jeolla) by repointing it to Daejeon, the adjacent central-region metropolis. Baekje: removed the unverifiable rank-system term "pummokgi," corrected the romanization of 귀족 (*gwijok*, not "guiok"), and fixed the noble clan name to Jin (眞, not "Jinsu"). Confirmed single-ISO front-matter dates (2026-09-09) on all three files.
